motif: A glowing Chama-Piloto yellow (#FFE600) furnace slit set low in every body, with one riveted Ferro de Caldeira smoke pipe (stub, tall or tripled) and a Latão de Poço brass band. The slit and the pipe are the race signature. The body colours below vary by building.

buildings.why: Flat box with a mast and diagonal cable. Bomber Factory grows the same shed.
Heavy stepped bunker with a stub pipe. It grows the Gun Smith's low terraced mass into a wider, heavier-roofed one.
Tank chain span, shown as a gantry crane over the bay. The sawtooth roof and hook arm are the additions.
Barrel dynamo with a dome and a cable tail. Red Shield grows the same drum.
Same shed family as the Aircraft Factory, but longer, with an open end wall and two masts. Its colour is paler than the parent's tan.
Half-buried mound with a hatch lid and one vent. The Rocket Lab keeps the pit and adds a lean.
The race's only lattice column, topped with a bulb cluster. It is the only tall tower.
Wide foundry hump with a glowing crucible mouth and one off-centre pipe. The Precious Golem Factory grows from it.
Open shed with a rack wall of torch tubes, built as low stacked terraces. The Arsenal is the stepped, closed upgrade.
Widest box in the tank family, with a gantry straddling the hull and a rail tail. It keeps the tank chain's span.
The exposed toothed saw wheel is a ring. The Protection Center grows the ring into a crown.
Thin tank-chain span with a funnel hopper on one shoulder. It is the narrowest profile in the family.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: Three staggered stacks and a side column make the three-peak skyline. It is the largest mass in the race.

It keeps the Golem Factory's foundry base. Twin stacks and a headframe wheel rise from it, so the contour changes from wide and low to narrow and tall. It does not duplicate the Energy Tower: it is a dome base with a twin-spire crown.
The Lumber Mill's ring is grown into a fortified crown. It has a balcony ring and a roof lamp.
A fatter version of the Blue Shield drum, with side coil banks and a crank arm. Its colour is clearly different from the blue.
The Demolition Lab's pit, with a crooked shed leaning above it on a diagonal launch rail. It is the only lopsided roof.
Heavy bay with a comb of brass tubes bolted on one side. It keeps the tank chain's span and grows the outline.
The race's only asymmetric junk-mound footprint, with one brazier vent.
The plain flat-roofed box with a ramp and a rail tail. It is the root of the tank chain, and every upgrade reads as an addition to it.
